name: output shape, gradients, and input preservation
input: a noncontiguous floating tensor with shape (2, 4, 8)
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(17)
model = MHA(2, 8).double()
x = torch.randn(2, 8, 4, dtype=torch.double).transpose(1, 2).detach().requires_grad_()
assert not x.is_contiguous()
snapshot = x.detach().clone()
out = model(x)
assert out.shape == x.shape and out.dtype == x.dtype
assert torch.isfinite(out).all()
out.square().sum().backward()
assert x.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(x.grad).all() and x.grad.abs().sum() > 0
parameter_grads = [p.grad for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
assert parameter_grads and all(g is not None and torch.isfinite(g).all() for g in parameter_grads)
assert torch.equal(x.detach(), snapshot)
print('ok')

name: True entries block future-token influence
input: a boolean upper-triangular mask with True above the diagonal
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(23)
model = MHA(2, 8).double().eval()
x = torch.randn(2, 4, 8, dtype=torch.double)
changed = x.clone()
changed[:, 2:] = torch.randn_like(changed[:, 2:]) * 20
mask = torch.ones(4, 4, dtype=torch.bool).triu(diagonal=1)
masked = model(x, mask)
masked_changed = model(changed, mask)
torch.testing.assert_close(masked[:, :2], masked_changed[:, :2])
unmasked = model(x)
unmasked_changed = model(changed)
assert not torch.allclose(unmasked[:, :2], unmasked_changed[:, :2])
print('ok')

name: False entries allow attention
input: an all-False boolean mask for sequence lengths 1 and 3
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(31)
for length in (1, 3):
    model = MHA(2, 8).double().eval()
    x = torch.randn(1, length, 8, dtype=torch.double)
    allow_all = torch.zeros(length, length, dtype=torch.bool)
    actual = model(x, allow_all)
    expected = model(x, None)
    assert actual.shape == x.shape
    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
print('ok')
